records.text: For if you refuse to listen at this time, help and shelter will come to the Jews from elsewhere, but you and your father’s house will perish. Who knows whether you became queen for this time?’”
Esther sent the man who had come to her back to Mordecai, saying:

“Go, assemble the Jews in Susa, and all of you fast for me. Neither eat nor drink for three days, night and day; I and my maids will also go without food. Then I will enter the king’s presence contrary to the law, even if I must perish.”
Mordecai went and did everything Esther commanded him,
